purpose: Convert the ESS-1000 gap ledger into deterministic parallel closure work without overstating implementation progress.

snapshot.note: Planning default severity is not an incident declaration. Runtime evidence may raise or lower an open gap within the non-compensable policy, with E0 reserved for active existential regressions/incidents.

execution_model.cross_lane_parallelism: allowed unless shared mutation/resource/dependency conflict requires serialization

priority_semantics.E0: runtime-only existential incident/regression class; never assigned merely because an essential is open
priority_semantics.E1: high-risk platform minimums involving authority, integrity, privacy, recovery, supply chain, durable state or AI action/weight governance
priority_semantics.E2: trustworthy-operation minimums involving contracts, delivery, testing, operability, data and runtime assurance
priority_semantics.selection: Use hard_order from the priority policy; planning defaults only break ties when no active evidence-based severity exists.

closure_batch_rules: Do not batch stages that require evidence produced by an earlier stage in the same lane.
Independent lanes may close in parallel and submit separate closure receipts.
A failure or stale evidence in one lane reopens only dependent lanes unless the affected invariant is globally non-compensable.
ESS-S100 cannot start until every one of ESS-S001..ESS-S099 has a current stage-10 closure receipt.
No batch may convert planned, specified or evidence-incomplete states directly to signed_current without the closure protocol.

lanes.execution_rule: Advance only to the next stage after the preceding stage has current closure evidence; independent lanes may run concurrently when mutation/resource conflicts are absent.
